settings.headline: Admissions at Larkmoor
settings.subtitle: How to apply, deadlines, what it costs, financial aid and how to visit. Larkmoor College is fictional, and this site does not take applications or payments.

settings.headline: Three steps, no surprises
settings.intro: Most first-year applicants finish in a few weeks. Transfer students follow the same steps with college transcripts.

items.title: Visit or meet us online
items.text: Tour campus, sit in on a class, or meet an admissions counselor by video. It is optional, but it helps.

items.title: Send your application
items.text: On a real college site this links to the application portal. On this demo there is no application form.

items.title: Share transcripts and one recommendation
items.text: Test scores are optional. A teacher or counselor recommendation is required.

settings.headline: Application deadlines for fall 2027
settings.intro: Dates are part of the fictional story.

items.label: Transfer
items.note: Rolling review after the deadline if space remains.

items.label: Financial aid forms
items.note: For need-based aid. Merit scholarships need no extra form.

settings.headline: What Larkmoor costs, and who helps pay
settings.body:
In this story, nine in ten Larkmoor students receive grants or scholarships, and the average first-year aid package covers more than half of tuition. A net price calculator would live here on a real site.

Every admitted student is reviewed for merit scholarships automatically.

settings.headline: Plan a visit
settings.body:
Student-led tours leave Ashby Commons on weekdays at 10:00 am and 2:00 pm, and on most Saturday mornings during the school year. Each tour takes about an hour and ends at the Calder River overlook.

You can add a class visit or a meeting with a professor in your field. Visitor parking is free in Lot C. See the campus map and the admissions events.

There are no sign-up forms on this demo site. On a real site this section would link to the visit scheduler.
